An '''Ishi Tib-cracked coconut''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]].<ref name="Ishi Tib Databank">{{DB|species|ishitib|Ishi Tib}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold an [[iced donut with shredded Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] also offered Ishi Tib-cracked coconut [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] as an optional flavoring for the [[fizzyglug]] drinks it sold.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ishi Tib-cracked coconuts were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
